questions.question: Which of the following is used to control pest fish?
questions.solution:
__**Piscicides**__ is used to **control pest fish.**

 
• **A piscicide** is a chemical substance that is** toxic to fish.**
 
• The use of piscicides is to eliminate a dominant fish species in a body of water, as the first step in trying to populate the water body with a different fish.
 
• They are also used to fight fish species which are parasitic and invasive.
 
• Examples of piscicides include **saponins, rotenone, TFM, Antimycin A (Fintrol) and niclosamide.**

questions.question: Berach River, a southern-side tributary of Banas River, originates from the hills in which of the following districts of Rajasthan?
questions.solution:
**Berach River**, a southern-side tributary of Banas River, originates from the hills in the __**Udaipur districts**__ of **Rajasthan.**

 
• The river is a part of the **basin of the Ganga River**.
 
• It flows northeast through the** districts of Udaipur, Chittorgarh, and Bhilwara, and enters the Banas near Bhilwara**.
 
• **The Banas River** is a tributary of the Chambal River, a tributary of the Yamuna itself, which in turn merges into the Ganga.
 
• The length of the Banas river is **512 km.**

questions.question: The International Naval event 'Milan' was scheduled to be held in ______ in March 2020.
questions.solution:
The International Naval event **'Milan'** was scheduled to be held in __**Visakhapatnam**__ in **March 2020**.

 
• The Indian Navy had postponed the exercise due to the **coronavirus pandemic in early March 2020**.
 
• Milan is a multilateral naval exercise under the **Andaman and Nicobar Command, hosted by the Indian Navy.**
 
• The first edition of this event was held in **1995.**
 
• Milan's most recent version took place at **HQENC Visakhapatnam 08 Nov 2019. 29 delegates from 17 friendly international navies participated in the three-day conference.**
 
• The 2020 edition would have been the largest edition of the exercise with 30 foreign navies having confirmed their participation.

questions.question: Which of the following authorities launched PPRTMS (Political Parties Registration Tracking Management System)?
questions.solution:
